summary.directAnswer: Found the smallest useful files for Next.js app auth, WebSocket auth, Lambda handlers, and Prisma data models. Key auth files: middleware.ts for route protection, auth/jwt.ts and auth/session.ts for token management, auth/api-route-access.ts for API policy, and login/route.ts for login flow.
